# ii. Accounts and Logging In {.unnumbered}

Most of PACS — the site database and every interactive model page — is available
only to logged-in users. This keeps each user's uploaded site data private to
their account.

## Register

1. From the top bar choose **Register**.
2. Provide a username, a valid email address, and a password.
3. Submit — you are returned to the login page.

Passwords must satisfy the site's password policy (a minimum length and
complexity). The email address is unique: one account per email.

## Log in

1. Choose **Login** and enter your email and password.
2. On success you land back on the home page, now signed in.

::: {.callout-note}
Login is rate-limited (a few attempts per minute) to protect accounts. If you are
temporarily blocked after several failed attempts, wait a minute and try again.
:::

## Log out

Use **Log out** in the top bar. On a shared machine, always log out when you are
done — your site data stays tied to your account.

## Your data

- Uploaded site rows belong to your account and are not visible to other users.
- Deleting your account removes all of your site data with it.
- For a full description of what is stored and your rights, see the site's
  **Privacy** and **Imprint** pages (linked in the footer of the app).
